object.body:
Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to $data.operationType.toLowerCase() the $data.machineIdentitySubtype.toLowerCase() $data.machineIdentityName on the $data.sourceName has failed.

Reason for failure: $data.failureReason.

Please contact your administrator for assistance.


Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to a requester to notify that their resource lifecycle request has been failed.
object.name: Resource Lifecycle Request Failed
object.subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request failed for $data.machineIdentityName
